scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @meshterm/server build && vite build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:gate: pnpm --filter @meshterm/server build && vite build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts --project gate --repeat-each 3
scripts.test:visual: pnpm --filter @meshterm/server build && vite build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts --project visual-desktop --project visual-mobile
scripts.test:visual:update: pnpm --filter @meshterm/server build && vite build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts --project visual-desktop --project visual-mobile --update-snapshots
